# One case per line: R (refuse) or A (allow), a space, then the Bash command.
# <NL> stands for a newline inside the command. Runs with AGENTIC_SDLC_COMMIT_PATHSPEC=1
# in a clean scratch repo (no merge or rebase in progress).
R git commit -m "fix: x"
R git commit -am "fix: x"
R git commit --all -m x
R git add a.sh && git commit -m x
R git commit -F - <<'EOF'<NL>fix: x<NL>EOF
R git -C . commit -m "x" --
R bash -c 'git commit -m x'
A git commit -m "fix: x" -- src/a.sh
A git commit -m "fix: x" src/a.sh
A git commit -F - -- src/a.sh <<'EOF'<NL>fix: x<NL>EOF
A git commit --amend --no-edit
A git commit --dry-run
A git commit -p
A git commit --pathspec-from-file=list.txt -m x
A git commit -m "do not run git commit -a" -- a.sh
A git status
A git log --grep commit
